content.text:
`program.dfy` now verifies: 9 verified, 0 errors.

**What was wrong:** the second postcondition of `binarySearchRec` (line 54) was wrong. It's a bridge failure. The postcondition promised `v[w] > elem + 1` for every `w > p`, but the precondition only guarantees `v[k] > elem` for `k > f`. In the base case (`c == f+1`), `p = f`, so an element equal to `elem + 1` right after `p` breaks the postcondition. That's the case the counterexample shows: `elem = 5941`, `v[1] = 5942`.

**Fix:** I changed that part of the postcondition to `v[w] > elem`. This matches both the precondition and the iterative `binarySearch` method.

**Extra change:** after that fix, `dafny verify` still exited with code 2 because of an indentation warning at line 80, in `otherbSearch`, which was already in the file. I put parentheses around the right-hand side of `!b ==> ...` there. It parsed that way already, so the meaning is unchanged.

The diagnosis is recorded in `diagnosis.json` (ensures / bridge).
